restaurantName: Miao Kou Ya Xiang Fan (Zhongshan Road)
address: 142 Zhongshan Road, North District, Hsinchu City, Taiwan
bio: This household name has been sitting right next to Hsinchu City God Temple for over 30 years. At mealtimes, it is always jam-packed with hungry diners who don’t mind waiting for their signature duck rice. The must-try dish is finely shredded smoked duck over a bed of steamed rice, drizzled with a secret, umami-laden sauce. You can also order different smoked duck cuts on their own or the equally enticing duck meatball soup.
pageTitle: Miao Kou Ya Xiang Fan (Zhongshan Road)
